name: bulk-shopper
description: Lets Claude pull hundreds of eBay UK and Etsy UK listings at once, filtered, with price summaries. Uses your own Chrome. No API keys.
long_description: Ask Claude to search eBay or Etsy and it reads whole results pages in a Chrome window on your computer: up to 240 eBay listings per page, up to 5 pages per search, including sold prices. It filters them (price, condition, postage, seller feedback, words to exclude), summarises prices (lowest, quartiles, median, highest) and gives a compact table with links, then can open the best listings for postage, returns and details. Because it uses your own browser and connection, eBay and Etsy see a normal visitor. If a site asks you to confirm you're human, do it in the Chrome window and ask again. Read-only: it never buys, bids or messages anyone.

tools.name: ebay_search
tools.description: Bulk search eBay UK (up to 5 pages of 240), including sold prices

tools.name: open_listings
tools.description: Open up to 8 eBay or Etsy listings for full details

hide_browser.title: Hide the browser window
hide_browser.description: Run Chrome invisibly. Leave this off if eBay or Etsy ask you to confirm you're human, because you need the window to do that.
